stem: What can the reader conclude about students who participate in the program based on information throughout the selection “Public Speaking Is Easier When a Cute Dog Is Listening”?
instruction: Use “Public Speaking Is Easier When a Cute Dog Is Listening” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: Students who participate in the program are afraid the first time they practice their speeches with an audience dog.

options.label: B
options.text: It is common for students in the program to deliver their speeches in less time.

options.label: C
options.text: It is difficult for students to find a time to practice when an audience dog is available.

options.label: D
options.text: Students who participate in the program will feel more prepared when they deliver their actual speech.
